knowledge.name: Active customer
knowledge.summary: A customer with at least one active service on the reporting date.
knowledge.definition: A customer with at least one active service on the reporting date.
knowledge.logic: At least one service is active as of the reporting date. A billing account alone does not qualify.
knowledge.exclusions: Prospects and customers with no active service.

knowledge.name: Customer
knowledge.summary: A person or organisation with a service relationship.
knowledge.definition: A person or organisation that holds, or has held, a service relationship with the business.
knowledge.logic: Identified by the canonical customer identifier.

knowledge.name: Account
knowledge.summary: A commercial agreement grouping services and billing.
knowledge.definition: A commercial account that groups services and their billing obligations under an agreement.

knowledge.name: Active customers
knowledge.summary: Distinct customers with an active service on the reporting date.
knowledge.definition: The count of distinct customer identifiers that satisfy the Active customer definition on the reporting date.
knowledge.aggregation: Distinct count; not additive over time
knowledge.exclusions: Prospects, test accounts and customers without an active service.

knowledge.name: Customer lifecycle
knowledge.definition: A maintained guide to onboarding, active service, suspension and termination. Each state links to an approved definition and accountable owner.

knowledge.name: Exclude suspended accounts
knowledge.summary: A narrower eligibility rule discovered in a retention template.
knowledge.definition: Exclude customers whose only service is suspended from the retention reporting population.
knowledge.logic: Candidate rule only. Excluded from agent context until reviewed.

knowledge.name: Customer churn rate
knowledge.summary: Customers leaving active service within a reporting period.
knowledge.definition: Customers who leave active service during the period divided by customers active at the beginning of that period.
knowledge.formula: Customers leaving active service / opening active customers
knowledge.aggregation: Recalculate ratio; do not sum percentages

knowledge.name: Onboarding complete
knowledge.summary: The first contracted service is available for use.
knowledge.definition: A customer reaches onboarding complete when their first contracted service is activated and available for use.

knowledge.name: Active customer
knowledge.summary: A customer with a billable account during the accounting period.
knowledge.definition: A customer with at least one billable account during the accounting period, including temporarily suspended services that remain billable.
knowledge.logic: Billing eligibility, not active service, determines membership.
knowledge.exclusions: Closed accounts and non-billable trial agreements.

knowledge.name: Monthly recurring revenue
knowledge.definition: Recurring contracted charges normalised to a calendar month, excluding one-off fees and usage charges.
knowledge.aggregation: Additive over accounts, not over monthly snapshots

knowledge.name: Overdue balance
knowledge.summary: Unpaid contractual amounts after their due date.
knowledge.definition: The amount contractually due and unpaid after the applicable payment deadline, excluding disputed balances awaiting review.

knowledge.name: Service
knowledge.summary: A contracted capability provided to a customer.
knowledge.definition: A contracted capability provided to a customer, with an independently managed service state.

knowledge.name: Service state
knowledge.summary: Allowed service states and their declared transitions.
knowledge.definition: A service has one effective state at a time: pending, active, suspended or terminated. Transitions carry a business-valid timestamp.

knowledge.name: Individual customer
knowledge.definition: A natural person participating in a customer relationship.
knowledge.summary: A natural person participating in a customer relationship.

knowledge.name: Contract
knowledge.definition: A commercial agreement consisting of contract lines.
knowledge.summary: A commercial agreement consisting of contract lines.

knowledge.name: Contract line
knowledge.definition: A separately specified service obligation within a contract.
knowledge.summary: A separately specified service obligation within a contract.
